name: presolve-554-holdout-300
description: Frozen holdout validation of abort fraction 0.01, the only discovery candidate passing the registered work-activity and nonnegative-quality gate. Its discovery process timing was worse, so this is validation rather than a default recommendation. Twelve disjoint base families, one satOptimized CP arm, three seeds and two alternating repeats on the same frozen source. No other candidate is selected using holdout outcomes.
